# featbit_group (Resource)

Manages one FeatBit Group's settings through the documented public API. Group members and Policies are managed by separate binding resources.

Terraform owns only the Group's existence, name, and description. Member and
Policy relationships are separate exact-pair resources; they are never folded
into this resource as authoritative collections.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "featbit_group" "example" {
  name        = "Checkout developers"
  description = "Scoped access for the checkout team"
}
```

## Lifecycle

- `name` and `description` update in place; an omitted description
  canonicalizes to an empty string.
- Create requires the organization-scoped, case-sensitive exact name to be
  absent and never adopts an existing Group automatically.
- Because the public Group delete operation cascades relationships, Destroy
  first requires the complete Member and Policy collections to be empty.
  Destroy binding resources before the Group.
- The `featbit_group` data source can observe an existing Group without
  adopting its settings or relationships.

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Group display name.

### Optional

- `description` (String) Group description. An omitted value canonicalizes to an empty string.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Group UUID.

## Import

Import a Group with its UUID:

```shell
terraform import featbit_group.example '<group_uuid>'
```

The identifier must use 8-4-4-4-12 hexadecimal UUID form. Import adopts only
the Group settings, not any Member or Policy relationship.
